title: From Splats to Silicon: Rethinking Computational Efficiency of 3DGS
abstract: arXiv:2609.06157v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) represents scenes with explicit primitives and supports real-time novel-view synthesis, yet its system efficiency varies substantially across scenes, viewpoints, rendering paths, and platform constraints. Existing studies pursue efficiency through representation and algorithm design, GPU runtime optimization, and architectural support, but their reported gains correspond to different points along the rendering and update paths. Connecting these indicators to end-to-end system benefit requires tracing how each optimization changes Gaussian selection, screen-space work, data movement, and stage or frame time. We therefore use a workload-centric framework to connect representation and algorithm research, GPU runtimes, and hardware architectures and to identify recurring workload patterns. translated_title: 从Splat到硅片：重新思考3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的计算效率
translated_abstract: 3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）使用显式基元表示场景，并支持实时新视角合成，但其系统效率在不同场景、视点、渲染路径和平台约束之间存在显著差异。现有研究通过表示与算法设计、GPU运行时优化以及硬件架构支持来追求效率提升，但它们所报告的性能增益对应于渲染与更新路径上的不同环节。要将这些指标与端到端系统收益联系起来，需要追踪每项优化如何改变高斯基元选择、屏幕空间计算量、数据移动以及各阶段或单帧耗时。因此，我们采用一个以工作负载为中心的分析框架，将表示与算法研究、GPU运行时和硬件架构联系起来，并识别其中反复出现的工作负载模式。我们通过对选定实现进行复现测量和受控的GPU性能剖析来补充文献分析。
tldr: 本文提出了一个以工作负载为中心的系统分析框架，将3DGS在算法、GPU运行时和硬件架构三个层面的效率优化研究统一起来，通过追踪每项优化对高斯选择、屏幕空间计算、数据移动和帧时间的影响，来衡量其真实的端到端系统收益。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a workload-centric framework that unifies 3DGS efficiency research across algorithms, GPU runtimes, and hardware architectures, tracing how each optimization affects Gaussian selection, screen-space work, data movement, and frame time to quantify its true end-to-end system benefit.
